skills.name: Subtract like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that have the same denominator.

skills.name: Subtract unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers and whole numbers to improper fractions.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms and convert improper fractions to mixed numbers.
